verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a personal-assistant service that indexes user email and other data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent controls: deleting indexed external data, revoking Google access, opting out of training, and one user deleting his account. Nothing documents exporting user data in any format, open or otherwise.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
